content: Continuation recall found no prior global-memory findings, verifier outcomes, or accepted facts. Target: finite undirected G is bipartite iff it has no odd cycle. Direct route solved: bipartite cycles alternate classes; conversely root a spanning tree in each component and color by tree-depth parity. If edge uv has equal depth parity, the unique T-path has even length, so it plus uv is a simple odd cycle. No external theorem is needed.
